facts.fact: Finn 在 Allard 家巨大的厨房中间等面试，双手插在裤袋里，等着被对方打量。
facts.anchor: Finn stands in the middle of the Allards’ giant kitchen

facts.fact: 他面试迟到，是因为先前把那个叫 Caren 的女人送回了家。
facts.anchor: He was late for the interview after helping that Caren woman back to her house

facts.fact: 草坪与“监狱屋”后院之间的黄杨树篱上还挂着一条金色花环，是派对留下的残迹。
facts.anchor: A gold garland stretches across the boxwood hedge that separates the lawn from the backyard of the Prison House

facts.fact: 被对方盯着打量时，他仍会不舒服，全身进入戒备。
facts.anchor: He still doesn’t like to be stared at like this

facts.fact: Jo 把他带到后门，直接把自家门锁密码告诉了这个刚见面的人。
facts.anchor: Jo opens the back door and tells him the code to her house

facts.fact: Jo 想起来，是 Paula Dunker 向她提到 Finn 的。
facts.anchor: You live with Paula Dunker, right?

facts.fact: 那张塔罗牌是 Autumn 在他手术前一天送给他的。
facts.anchor: Autumn gave it to him the day before his surgery.

facts.fact: 他离开前问自己：住在这栋房子里的人，是不是杀了 Autumn 的人。
facts.anchor: Did someone who lives in this house kill Autumn?
